content: Current Ratio = Current Assets ÷ Current Liabilities. Compute the ratio by dividing the total current assets by the total current liabilities.

When presenting numeric financial ratios, round the result to two decimal places (nearest hundredth) if it has more than two decimal places, and output the value as a plain floating‑point number without any additional formatting.

Do not round intermediate values before performing the division; round only after the final ratio is computed. Also, avoid presenting the ratio with extra text or formatting that could be misinterpreted.
